content.title: ifm electronic 411-1657 Inductive Proximity Sensor, 10-30 VDC, 1.5 ms Response
content.short_description: ifm electronic 411-1657 is an inductive proximity sensor operating on 10-30 VDC supply with a 1.5 ms response time.
content.long_description:
The ifm electronic 411-1657 is an inductive proximity sensor designed for non-contact detection of metallic targets in industrial control and automation applications. It operates on a supply voltage range of 10-30 VDC, allowing integration with standard low-voltage DC control systems.

This sensor has a response time of 1.5 ms, indicating the speed at which it can detect a target and switch its output state. This characteristic should be evaluated against the application's target speed and switching frequency requirements.

As an inductive proximity sensor, the 411-1657 is intended for detecting the presence or absence of metal objects without physical contact, commonly used in machine position sensing, part detection, and end-of-travel confirmation within industrial equipment and automation lines.

Procurement and maintenance personnel should confirm supply voltage compatibility (10-30 VDC) and response time (1.5 ms) against system requirements prior to installation or replacement.
